title: Strategy Wiki RAG integration
description: Integrate Wiki retrieval into the Strategist agent: before generating a CampaignBrief, query canonical + validated wiki entries from hook_pattern, audience_persona, and anti_pattern namespaces. Inject top-k results as context. Log retrieval count (must be >= 5 entries/call per FR-ST-02).
sub_tasks: Create WikiRetriever with retrieve(query, namespaces, top_k) method
Implement in-memory vector similarity (Phase 1, no pgvector required)
Wire WikiRetriever into Strategist.generate_brief() as pre-reasoning step
Add retrieval_log to CampaignBrief metadata (entries retrieved count)
Unit tests for retrieval, filtering by namespace, minimum entry count
